program.name: zupyTokenProgram
docs: ZUPY (Z$) loyalty token program — Pinocchio. Source: https://github.com/zupy-fmartinelli/zupy-token-program

instructions.name: initializeToken
docs: One-time setup: token_state PDA + Token-2022 mint. Only the treasury (story 36.3).

instructions.name: updateMetadataField
docs: Update one metadata field (treasury). field: 0 = name, 1 = symbol, 2 = uri.

instructions.name: mintTokens
docs: Mint Z$ to the treasury ATA within the token_state limits (mint authority).

instructions.name: treasuryRestockPool
docs: Move Z$ from the treasury ATA to the pool ATA (treasury signs).

instructions.name: transferFromPool
docs: Pool → recipient as a compressed leaf (reward).

instructions.name: returnToPool
docs: Store PDA compressed balance → pool ATA (decompress with validity proof).

instructions.name: transferCompanyToUser
docs: Store → customer reward (V1 compressed transfer, hardened; memo = ledger operation id). Followed by the V1 cToken CPI accounts (fee payer, authority = PDA, Light accounts, trees/queues).

arguments.name: v1Transfer
docs: V1 cToken TRANSFER instruction data (validated on-chain)

instructions.name: transferUserToCompany
docs: Customer → store spend (V1 compressed transfer). Followed by the V1 cToken CPI accounts (fee payer, authority = PDA, Light accounts, trees/queues).

arguments.name: v1Transfer
docs: V1 cToken TRANSFER instruction data (validated on-chain)

instructions.name: executeSplitTransfer
docs: Customer redemption split: store + incentive pool legs. Followed by the V1 cToken CPI accounts (fee payer, authority = PDA, Light accounts, trees/queues).

arguments.name: v1Transfer
docs: V1 cToken TRANSFER instruction data (validated on-chain)

instructions.name: initializeRateLimit
docs: Create the rate-limit PDA of an authority.

instructions.name: createZupyCard
docs: Mint the customer loyalty card NFT (mint authority).

instructions.name: createCouponNft
docs: Mint a coupon NFT to the customer PDA (mint authority).

instructions.name: mintCouponCnft
docs: Mint a compressed coupon NFT via Bubblegum (mint authority pays).

instructions.name: withdrawToExternal
docs: Customer compressed balance → external wallet ATA (decompress with validity proof).

instructions.name: returnUserToPool
docs: Customer PDA compressed balance → pool ATA (decompress with validity proof).

instructions.name: consolidateLeaves
docs: Merge 2..8 compressed leaves of one owner into one (same owner, exact sum). Followed by the V1 cToken CPI accounts (fee payer, authority = PDA, Light accounts, trees/queues).

arguments.name: v1Transfer
docs: V1 cToken TRANSFER instruction data (validated on-chain)

definedTypes.name: leafProof
docs: Leaf being spent + validity proof (144 bytes)
